name: 家私金属多材质改色自喷漆款
description: 罐装改色翻新喷涂剂，白底主图加深色留白卖点与信息图混排

styleLock.direction: premium DIY refinish commerce, flat graphic infographic fields mixed with clean studio product photography
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF packshot field, one deep matte #0C0A09 dark copy field for a benefit hero, pale #DBEAF5 infographic band on top of a matte concrete #C6C3BF work surface
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral high-key studio light, front-left soft key with fill card, soft contact shadows only, one skimming or sweeping highlight per detail shot, single consistent colour temperature
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte concrete worktop #C6C3BF, pale seamless studio ground #D3D0CB, raw timber and bare sheet-metal accents as substrate tiles
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one short headline plus at most four short labels, always generic placeholder copy, never a reproduction of source lettering
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-stroke callout lines ending in a small dot, single accent #1B75BC, no pictograms, no badges, no seals
styleLock.presentationRules: product stays upright with the cap end up at a stable slight 3/4 to straight-on angle, one consistent scale anchor, the coated result is always shown on real furniture or vessel props rather than on the product body
noDrift: no reproduced source label artwork or source lettering
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium DIY refinish commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a clean #FFFFFF packshot field, a pale #DBEAF5 infographic band, a matte concrete #C6C3BF work surface and one cobalt accent #1B75BC, with deep #0C0A09 reserved for a single dark benefit hero; neutral high-key studio lighting with a front-left soft key, fill card and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one short headline and at most four short labels; thin single-stroke callout lines ending in a dot as the only graphic device; clean product photography mixed with minimal flat infographic elements; stable upright slight 3/4 to straight-on product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no reproduced source lettering.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用直立全貌加干净白场拿住首图合规位
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, product upright with cap end at the top, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left soft key with fill card, soft contact shadow under the base
shots.whitespace: no reserved copy area, clean margin only around the silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product stands upright and centred, cap end at the top, seen straight-on at eye level with the full silhouette visible and nothing clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting from the front-left with a fill card on the shadow side, a soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure #FFFFFF packshot field, no props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, leaving only a clean margin around the silhouette and no reserved copy area. 8K commercial hardware e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no people, no watermark, no added callout text or arrows, no new or restyled logos, no tinted or gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating product without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒承接首图主张，把产品压到一角腾出大标题位
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, product anchored low in the lower-left third
shots.lighting: single soft key from the upper right skimming the surface, one rim highlight on the near edge, deep falloff into the field
shots.background: deep matte #0C0A09 field with a faint floor plane
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the upper and right 65% for the headline
shots.textZone: 右上大片暗场留白，一行短标题位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product is anchored low in the lower-left third at a slight 3/4 angle, cap end up, occupying 50-60% of the frame height. A single soft key light from the upper right skims across the surface, laying down one rim highlight along the near edge with a deep falloff into the field. Deep matte #0C0A09 background with a faint floor plane and no props. Generous negative space across the upper and right 65% of the frame, where one short line reading 「{callout_1}」 sits in #FFFFFF. Negative: no second unit, no props, no hands, no dense body text, no more than one headline, no invented numbers or multiples, no gradient sweep, no lens flare, no watermark, no added logos.

shots.intent: 放大旧家具掉色划花的难看现场，逼出改色动机
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward at the worn piece, product half in frame at the right
shots.lighting: lower-key and heavier than the rest of the set, flat top light on the worn face, one soft directional key from the left
shots.background: matte concrete worktop #C6C3BF under a muted #D9D6D1 wall
shots.props: one tired timber-and-metal furniture part with a faded, scratched surface
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the scene fills the frame edge to edge
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point screen. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward at a worn, faded, scratched timber-and-metal furniture part resting on a matte concrete worktop #C6C3BF against a muted #D9D6D1 wall, while {product} stands at the right edge of the frame, half in shadow. Light is deliberately lower-key and heavier on the weathered side, with one soft directional key from the left and flat top light skimming low across the tired surface. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame and the worn surface carries the rest, with no extra whitespace and no copy area. Negative: no people or faces, no hands, no mould, no insects, no rust flakes or contamination detail, no dirt piles, no extra text, no fabricated before-and-after results, no invented repair claims, no watermark, no added logos.

shots.intent: 用喷嘴与按压头的做工特写证明出雾与握持设计
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at a slight 3/4 angle on the tip assembly, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft skimming light from the right revealing rib texture, one controlled specular, no blown highlights
shots.background: clean #FFFFFF field easing out of focus behind the tip
shots.whitespace: minimal whitespace, the macro detail is the subject
shots.textZone: 顶部窄条标题区，下方一条指向线
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, photographed at a slight 3/4 angle with a tight zoom on the actuator pad and spray orifice at the top of the product. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground edge sharp and a clean #FFFFFF field falling softly out of focus behind it. A soft skimming light from the right reveals the fine rib texture of the pad while keeping one controlled specular and no blown highlights. One thin #1B75BC callout line with a dot terminal drops from a short headline reading 「{callout_1}」 in #2B2B2B. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace around it. Negative: no blurry subject, no visible hand or fingers, no liquid droplets, no duplicated or extra nozzle parts, no dense body text, no invented mechanism claims, no watermark, no added logos.

shots.intent: 用盖顶同色样这件小事打消拿错色的顾虑
shots.camera: close-up detail shot from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto the fitted cap
shots.lighting: even soft front studio light with one sweeping highlight across the top face
shots.background: upper #DBEAF5 band over a clean #FFFFFF lower field
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond the top band
shots.textZone: 顶部雾蓝横条标题区，居中一行
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot of {product} photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto the fitted cap, tight zoom on the cap top face and its side ribbing. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft front studio light with one sweeping highlight travelling across the top face so the finish reads clearly, depth of field easing gently toward the barrel. Field split into an upper #DBEAF5 band holding one short headline reading 「{callout_1}」 in #2B2B2B and a clean #FFFFFF lower field. The detail occupies 55-60% of the frame with no extra whitespace beyond the band. Negative: no hands, no removed or detached cap, no duplicated cap, no visible scratches dust or fingerprints, no tiny unreadable text, no invented colour-matching guarantees, no watermark, no added logos.

shots.intent: 用四块基材半覆膜对比把可附着范围讲成一眼看懂的结构
shots.camera: flat lay from a top-down 90-degree overhead angle, matched framing on all four tiles
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow, one soft contact edge under each tile
shots.background: matte concrete worktop #C6C3BF below a top #DBEAF5 band
shots.props: four square substrate tiles: bare timber, bare sheet metal, woven rattan, smooth moulded plastic
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, only even gutters between tiles
shots.textZone: 顶部横条标题区，四格各一条标签位与指向线
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison infographic, flat lay photographed from a top-down 90-degree overhead angle. Four square substrate tiles sit on a matte concrete worktop #C6C3BF in a 2x2 grid, bare timber, bare sheet metal, woven rattan and smooth moulded plastic, each tile left half raw and right half coated in an even film of {accent_color} applied from {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow and one soft contact edge under each tile. A top #DBEAF5 band carries one short headline reading 「{callout_1}」 in #2B2B2B, and each tile has one empty label slot with a thin #1B75BC pointer line ending in a dot. The tiles together occupy 50-60% of the frame with even gutters and no extra whitespace. Negative: no fabricated results, no mismatched framing or lighting between tiles, no peeling flaking, no mould dust or insects, no dense body text, no invented coverage or adhesion figures, no watermark, no added logos.

shots.intent: 把施工动作与渐变效果同框，让买家代入自己动手
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile, product held at the upper right, vessel at the lower left
shots.lighting: soft directional key from the upper left at 5500K, plume kept translucent, gentle contact shadow under the vessel
shots.props: one ribbed ceramic vessel, half coated as a soft gradient
shots.whitespace: generous open space above and between the product and the vessel
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle action scene photographed at a clean 90-degree side profile: one hand entering from the upper right presses the top of {product}, a fine translucent plume travelling down-left toward a ribbed ceramic vessel standing on a seamless pale studio ground #EFEFED, the vessel half coated in a soft gradient of {accent_color}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft directional key from the upper left at 5500K, the plume back-lit so it stays airy and translucent, with a gentle contact shadow under the vessel. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with generous open space above and between the two objects. Negative: no visible face, no more than one hand, no deformed or extra fingers, no opaque saturated cloud, no puddles or drips on the ground, no extra props, no clutter, no extra text, no watermark, no added logos.

shots.intent: 展示成品效果与质感，作为改色成果的场景证据
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level still life, full chair visible with the product beside a front leg
shots.lighting: bright soft studio light from the front-left, broad clean highlights running along the seat edge, soft contact shadows under the legs
shots.props: one refinished chair as the result piece, the product as the scale anchor
shots.whitespace: generous uncluttered margin around the chair
shots.promptTemplate: Result still life scene: a refinished chair carrying an even coat of {accent_color} applied with {product} stands at a slight 3/4 eye-level angle on a pale seamless studio ground #D3D0CB, the product resting upright on the ground beside one front leg as the scale anchor. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright soft studio lighting from the front-left, broad clean highlights running along the seat edge so the sheen reads, soft contact shadows under all four legs. The chair and product together occupy 40-50% of the frame with generous uncluttered margin around them. Negative: no people, no hands, no clutter or extra furniture, no dust scratches or brush marks in the coating, no floating legs, no invented durability or warranty claims, no extra text, no watermark, no added logos.

shots.intent: 把可选光泽做成四格选单，让买家自己挑规格
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view of a 2x2 panel grid, panels fill the frame
shots.lighting: even high-key light with one identical broad highlight per panel so the sheen steps compare fairly
shots.background: clean #FFFFFF field with thin #C6C3BF dividers and a top #DBEAF5 band
shots.props: four square coated sample panels, one small product unit at the lower right
shots.whitespace: tight even gutters, no extra whitespace
shots.textZone: 顶部横条标题区，四格各一条空标签位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant chooser infographic, photographed straight-on at eye level. Four square coated sample panels sit in a 2x2 grid on a clean #FFFFFF field divided by thin #C6C3BF rules, every panel the same {accent_color} film shown at a different sheen from low sheen to high sheen so the steps compare side by side. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key lighting with one identical broad highlight per panel. A top #DBEAF5 band carries one short headline reading 「{callout_1}」 in #2B2B2B and each panel has one empty label slot with a thin #1B75BC pointer line and dot; {product} appears once, small, at the lower right corner. The panels occupy 60-70% of the frame with tight even gutters and no extra whitespace. Negative: no mismatched lighting or angle between panels, no invented sheen percentages codes or gloss numbers, no dense text, no duplicated panels, no watermark, no added logos.

shots.intent: 用防护与打底辅料清单收口，降低新手施工风险感
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even bright high-key light, short soft shadows under each item, no dramatic falloff
shots.background: matte concrete worktop #C6C3BF with a wide #DBEAF5 cross band behind the centre
shots.props: folded drop cloth, roll of masking tape, sheet of abrasive paper, lint-free wipe, pair of gloves, safety eyewear
shots.whitespace: generous breathing room from the arrangement to all four edges
shots.textZone: 中央横条标题区，四周各一条空标签位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle on a matte concrete worktop #C6C3BF. {product} sits at the centre while the preparation items form a loose ring around it, a folded drop cloth, a roll of masking tape, a sheet of abrasive paper, a lint-free wipe, a pair of gloves and safety eyewear, each item paired with one empty label slot. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even bright high-key lighting with short soft shadows under each item and no dramatic falloff. A wide #DBEAF5 cross band behind the centre holds one short headline reading 「{callout_1}」 in #2B2B2B. The whole arrangement occupies 35-40% of the frame with generous breathing room to all four edges. Negative: no brand marks or lettering on the accessories, no unreadable tiny text, no invented certifications safety ratings or standards numbers, no duplicated items, no real person or hands, no clutter, no watermark, no added logos.

provenance.notes: 10 张源图逐图事实：01 纯白底直立罐身 packshot；02 产品缩至左下角、其余为深色大留白；03 改色后座椅成品静物（浅灰棚地、3/4 机位）；04 双色改色书桌加右上角大字号标题；05 顶部浅色标题带加水泥台 2x2 基材半覆盖对比格（木/金属/藤/塑）；06 单手持罐向陶瓷器皿喷涂、器皿带渐变改色；07 浅色标题带加罐盖顶部微距；08 浅色标题带加喷嘴按压头微距；09 光泽度 2x2 样板格加底部脚注；10 浅色场中央大标题加四周辅料环绕平铺。品类判定依据：源类目提示给到灯具/建材或家居日用，实拍产品为手摇罐装表面改色喷涂剂，作用于木器、金属、藤编、塑料等基材翻新，属家装涂料耗材而非带电器具，也非清洁护理用品，故定 L1 家装灯具 / L2 建材。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、罐身全部原英文字句与净重数字、原图英文标题句与脚注原句、倍数类主张、光泽等级具体名称、辅料图中工具上的原品牌字样、任何原平台店铺字样；产品一律以 {product} 占位，基材与光泽主张改为空标签位与 {callout_n} 占位，改色色值改用 {accent_color}。
